significance: A Venkateswara temple run by the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams on Venkatanarayana Road in T. Nagar, which by June 2024 had become the highest earning TTD temple after Tirumala itself. Its shrines include images of Hayagriva, Varaha, Rama, Krishna, Andal, Ranganatha, Lakshmi, Brahma and Ramanuja.
